meta.policy: Only venue-controlled pages and official PDFs substantiate values. Unknown values are blank and flagged. A guarantee is not a forecast of actual payouts. Ratio = guaranteed pool ÷ buy-in, descriptive only.
meta.formula: Trip cost = entries × buy-ins + nights × true hotel cost; true nightly = rate + resort fee + 13.38% tax (tax applies to rate and resort fee per Bellagio terms; Venetian terms state 13.38% Clark County room tax and 'plus applicable tax' on the fee).

flags.finding: The poker page link says '$1,000 NLH' (filename saturdays-$1000-nlh.pdf), the PDF header says 'NLH $1100 BUY-IN', and PDF rule 07 says 'Of the $600 Buy-in, $510 goes to the Prize Pool...'.

flags.title: Walking times not verified
flags.finding: No official venue publishes door-to-door walking times, and no map service result could be captured in this pass. Every hotel–venue pair carries a Google Maps walking link for manual verification; walkingMinutes is blank on all rows.
flags.next: Open each map link (walking mode) and record the time; the 30-minute filter will then apply to verified values.

flags.title: Date-specific hotel rates not published; checkout totals blank
flags.finding: Venetian/Palazzo publish poker-suite starting rates ($119/$209) not mapped to dates; Wynn, Bellagio and ARIA publish no static rate. All checkoutTotal / nightlyAvg fields are blank; the trip calculator computes them once a dated rate is entered.
flags.next: Fix trip dates (Workflow step 1), then pull each hotel's official booking link for those dates and log the dated quote in the rate log.

flags.title: Bellagio Saturday PDF references a stale Day 2 date
flags.finding: PDF rule 04 says 'Combined Final Day 2 (9/13/26) will begin at 12pm' inside a weekly tournament sheet; the date appears stale and the sheet also references Flights 1A–1D.
flags.next: Ask the room for the current Saturday structure.

flags.title: Golden Nugget / Resorts World / Circa / MGM Grand poker pages not retrievable
flags.finding: Golden Nugget returned empty content, Resorts World redirected to an email template, Circa failed to load, and the MGM Grand poker URL 404s. No rows were added for these rooms.
flags.next: Retry these official pages (or call the rooms) and add dated schedule rows when retrieved; the daily-check workflow will also retry them.

flags.title: No verified 8:00 AM tournament start
flags.finding: The earliest verified start across all checked official schedules is 9:10 AM (Venetian satellite #46, Dec 12) and 10:10 AM for regular events; no official schedule shows an 8:00 AM start in this window.
flags.next: If an 8 AM start is required, ask Horseshoe (6 daily tournaments, times unpublished) or Golden Nugget whether an early daily runs.

flags.title: Single-entry is never printed as a policy
flags.finding: No Venetian structure sheet prints 'single entry', 'freezeout', or a maximum-entries rule. Main-list rows are confirmed for date/time/buy-in/fee-split/guarantee and carry no re-entry/rebuy/add-on clause, but a one-entry limit is not stated in writing.
flags.next: Get written confirmation of one-entry-total / no-rebuy / no-add-on from tournament staff before treating any event as a strict freezeout.

flags.title: Est. finish times are structure-derived estimates
flags.finding: Duration estimates multiply printed level counts by level lengths plus printed breaks. Real events can end earlier (players bust) or later (final-table dynamics, TD discretion). Overlap flags use these estimates and are advisory only.
flags.next: Treat overlap flags as planning guidance; the poker room controls actual timing.
